environment: Chromium in the Claude desktop app browser pane, Windows desktop GPU. The pane was hidden/backgrounded, so requestAnimationFrame-based FPS could NOT be measured. All numbers are synthetic per-frame timings (2 x 1/120 s simulation steps + render), not real-device FPS. Mobile = Chrome device emulation (375x812, DPR capped to 1.5), NOT a real phone.

cpuRenderMsPerFrame_900x600.method: game.update + game.render CPU time, no GPU wait, 120 frames
cpuRenderMsPerFrame_900x600.note: Canvas 2D CPU time excludes rasterisation (done later by the browser); PixiJS CPU time includes building GPU batches and live canvas texture redraws.

frameMsWithGpuFinish.method: update x2 + render + gl.finish(), 240 frames, chaos after 2 bosses

dark.avgMs: 2.03-4.17 (7.28 right after a theme switch while textures re-bake)

stress_mobile_emulation_563x1218.method: fixed N bullets (5 shapes, 25% with trails), spawning frozen
